user.title: Connect Bloomery
user.description: In Bloomery open **Profile → Home Assistant & calendar**, tap **Create feed** and paste the integration URL here.

reconfigure.title: Update Bloomery link
reconfigure.description: Paste the new integration URL from Bloomery (needed after tapping **New token**).

reauth_confirm.title: Bloomery link changed
reauth_confirm.description: The integration URL no longer works (it was turned off or a new token was created). Paste the current URL from Bloomery → Profile → Home Assistant & calendar.

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a Bloomery integration URL (…/api/ha/TOKEN).
error.invalid_token: This link is no longer active. Create a new one in Bloomery.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Bloomery at that address from Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Bloomery account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That link belongs to a different Bloomery account.

feed_revoked.message: The Bloomery integration URL is no longer active. Create a new one in Bloomery and update the integration.

no_api_key.message: Add your Bloomery API key in the integration's options (Configure) to log from Home Assistant.

invalid_api_key.message: Bloomery rejected the API key. Create a new one in Bloomery and update the integration's options.

init.title: Logging from Home Assistant
init.description: Paste the API key from Bloomery → Profile → Shortcuts & automations to use the *Log period start* and *Log* actions. Leave it empty to turn the actions off.

data_description.api_key: Lets Home Assistant add logs to Bloomery. It can't read or delete anything.

error.invalid_api_key: Bloomery didn't accept that API key.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Bloomery at that address from Home Assistant.

log_period_start.name: Log period start
log_period_start.description: Marks the start of a period (and the expected next few days), like tapping Log period in the app.

config_entry_id.name: Bloomery account
config_entry_id.description: Which Bloomery account to log to.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to log for. Defaults to today.

log.name: Log
log.description: Adds symptoms, moods and other items to a day without removing anything already logged.

config_entry_id.name: Bloomery account
config_entry_id.description: Which Bloomery account to log to.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to log for. Defaults to today.

items.name: Items
items.description: Symptoms, moods and more by name or id, e.g. cramps, Headache or mood:sad.

note.name: Note
note.description: Text added to the day's notes.
